summary: Tested Screen Calculator page and SpecPackCTA lead capture functionality. All features working correctly - calculator renders with hero, configuration panel, results panel. Application buttons, sliders, content type, and environment toggles all respond to user input. Results update dynamically. SpecPackCTA shows lead-gated form with name, email, company, role fields. Form submission captures lead via POST /api/specpacks/{pack_id}/download and returns PDF download URL. Application Landing pages (/applications/retail) include SpecPackCTA in sidebar.
